ideas.pitch: An AI-powered risk intelligence platform tailored for Kansas agricultural supply chains, leveraging graph intelligence and LightGBM to predict regional supply bottlenecks and weather-driven logistics failures.
ideas.title: PrairieRisk AI: Agricultural Supply Chain Anomaly Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: It incorporates the proven high-performance pattern of graph intelligence and LightGBM seen in Bito, while hyper-localizing the context to the geographic and economic hub of Kansas for maximum judge relevance.

ideas.pitch: Automated satellite imagery monitoring platform to track unauthorized land use, zoning violations, and environmental changes across rural and urban Kansas infrastructure.
ideas.title: Midwest GeoMonitor: Satellite Land Compliance for Local Infrastructure
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the runner-up success of GeoNex-ATLAS by tackling industrial and geographic land compliance through automated geospatial analysis, appealing to regional infrastructure priorities.

ideas.pitch: A statistical forecasting dashboard predicting regional crop yields and weather-related agricultural incidents using Poisson regression and rolling backtests with calibrated 90 percent prediction intervals.
ideas.title: AgriYield AI: Localized Crop Forecasting & Calibrated Risk Intervals
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the mathematically rigorous approach of the AI incident forecasting winner, substituting generic AI safety with highly practical, actionable agricultural forecasting valuable to the local region.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven patient intake and trust-building platform designed for regional dental and medical clinics in Kansas to streamline patient acquisition and compliance education.
ideas.title: HealthTrust AI: Patient Acquisition & Trust Engine for Rural Kansas Clinics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the rapid-execution, high-impact healthcare trust engine model from the Global-Smile winner, tailored specifically to solve access-to-care challenges for underserved rural populations.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student support and resource optimization platform combining LangGraph, RAG, and personalized agents to track and reduce university carbon footprints and resource waste.
ideas.title: CampusGreen: Multi-Agent University Sustainability & Student Support Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on the multi-agent architecture and RAG implementation that secured 1st place in the GreenNovation Hackathon, offering immediate utility for campus administrators and student bodies.
